# /vt/ League 10

Squad of 23. A player's rating is his best of: clearing.

## Tiers
- **Gold**: 2 per team, 194 cm, swerve 99 to 99; every stat 99 (place kicking 96, defensive prowess 58); form 8, injury resistance 1, weak foot 4/4; 6 paid cards (at least 3), 2 free COM styles; 2 A positions.
- **Silver**: 3 per team, 194 cm, swerve 92 to 92; every stat 92 (attacking prowess 95, place kicking 88, defensive prowess 56, ball winning 88, stamina 95, aggression 88); form 8, injury resistance 1, weak foot 4/4; 7 paid cards (at least 3), 2 free COM styles; 3 A positions.
- **Regular**: 10 per team, any of (178 cm; 180 cm); every stat 77 (attacking prowess 87, ball control 87, dribbling 87, low pass 87, lofted pass 92, finishing 97, place kicking 70, swerve 87, defensive prowess 73, ball winning 68, kicking power 87, explosive power 73, physical contact 68, jump 67, goalkeeping 75, catching 70, reflexes 73, coverage 73, stamina 55, tight possession 87, aggression 92); form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 4/4; 7 paid cards (at least 3), 1 free COM style; 2 A positions.
- **Buffed**: 8 per team, 188 cm; every stat 77 (attacking prowess 92, ball control 87, dribbling 92, low pass 87, lofted pass 87, finishing 92, place kicking 70, swerve 87, defensive prowess 53, ball winning 68, kicking power 92, speed 88, explosive power 88, body control 88, physical contact 88, goalkeeping 75, catching 70, reflexes 73, coverage 73, stamina 60, tight possession 87, aggression 87); form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 4/4; 7 paid cards (at least 3), 1 free COM style; 1 A position.

## Every team
Every player is rated A at his registered position; no B ratings; GK is never a second A; age 15 to 50; weight between height − 129 (at least 30) and height − 81; at least 2 goalkeepers; at most 12 skill cards; at most 5 COM styles.

## Team settings
- **No man marking on PES 16** (PES 16): man marking off.
- **PES 16 support settings** (PES 16): automatic substitution off, automatic offside trap off, automatic preset change off.

## Special rules
- **The free skills**: Scissors Feint, Flip Flap, Marseille Turn, Sombrero, Cut Behind And Turn, Scotch Move, Acrobatic Finishing, Heel Trick, First Time Shot, Malicia, Double Touch, Crossover Turn or Step On Skill free.
- **The pass skills are free to non-medals**: Regular or Buffed: One Touch Pass, Weighted Pass or Pinpoint Crossing free.
- **The captain's Captaincy card is free**: The captain: Captaincy free.
- **Incisive Run and Long Ranger are free COM styles**: Incisive Run or Long Ranger free.
- **Malicia is required**: must hold Malicia.
- **Regulars cannot be captain**: Regular or Buffed, the captain: not allowed ("Regulars can't be captain").
- **Medals cannot be goalkeepers**: Gold or Silver, registered GK: not allowed ("Medals cannot play as GK").
- **188cm players have no A at CB or GK**: Buffed, rated A at CB or GK: not allowed ("188cm players may not have an A-position at CB or GK").
- **A goalkeeper's form is 8**: Regular, registered GK: +4 form.
- **Regular goalkeepers are 180cm**: Regular, registered GK, 178 cm: not allowed ("Regular goalkeepers must be 180cm").
- **Outfield regulars are 178cm**: Regular, 180 cm, except registered GK: not allowed ("Outfield regulars must be 178cm").
- **Buffed wingbacks are 2/2 weak foot**: Buffed, rated A at LB or RB: weak foot up to 2/2.
